title: Hamster Adventures in Vietnam
subtitle: A Cozy Journey Coloring Book for Adults
tagline: From the Northern Mountains to the Mekong Delta
author: Lanternsinthesky
back_blurb:
Follow a little traveler hamster on a journey across Vietnam. From misty mountain terraces and bustling old streets to golden rice fields, lantern-lit towns and the floating markets of the Mekong Delta, every single-sided page is a richly detailed scene packed with tiny characters, markets, festivals and village life.

Made for markers, gel pens and colored pencils. No experience needed: pick your favorite colors and enjoy a quiet, creative trip around the country.
